summary: ASUS TUF Dash F15 (2021) with Intel Core i7-12700H CPU, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 GPU, 16GB DDR5 RAM, and 512GB NVMe SSD experiencing thermal throttling issues due to CPU cooling.
suggested_solution: Use a single layer of FCR-AS thermal grease on both the CPU die and heatsink for optimal cooling performance.
